kine2go_gaits.subset: full reference motions tagged pace, trot, or canter
kine2go_gaits.license: multi-license; use each clip.json as authoritative
kine2go_gaits.notes: Downloads only ten small motion.npy reference trajectories and clip metadata. Rollouts, videos, policies, walk, turn, jump, crawl, scoot, and strafe clips are excluded. The three vhdc_horse1_s2 clips use 120 FPS because their stored joint velocities are consistent with 120 FPS rather than the metadata-declared 60 FPS.

nju_agility.notes: Provides all three SECAMP skill labels.

dogml.subset: unique robot motions whose complete text label is walk, trot, or run and which pass deterministic movement thresholds
dogml.license: not specified by the official repository or dataset archive; local research use only
dogml.notes: Uses the official 60 FPS root-motion plus 16-keypoint RIC schema. Mixed labels and stand, sit, lie, jump, spin, and other non-gait labels are excluded. Near-stationary clips and digest-identical motions carrying conflicting gait labels are also excluded. Motions are morphology-scaled and retargeted to Go2 with analytic inverse kinematics; walk maps to pace, trot to trot, and run to canter.
